free_tier.stated: free with a Cloudflare account; scans of the exact URL in the last 30 days

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a scan

retention.stated: 30 days: a scan older than that is not held, and a pinned request before it is a 400

interface_detail: REST; read service, never submitted by it
chaining: The archive fallback when the Wayback Machine is slow or holds nothing; a page it answers always points on to the other archives

limits.value: 240 requests a minute on this deployment's account window, shared with read, which keeps 4 free for a read lookup
30 days of reach; a request pinned to it outside that range is a 400 naming the reach
a listing reads the newest 100 scans of the URL; when that search is full and its oldest scan is after from, older scans are unknown

evidence.proved: cfscan is the scans of the exact URL in the last 30 days; a page it answers carries skip=cfscan and more=true; provider=cfscan outside the 30 days is a 400 naming its reach
200, 0 captures, more false, misses wayback none, arquivo none, commoncrawl unknown

notes: A 30-day window is not an archive.
